summary: Verified the HIGH bug fix from iteration_4: Users.jsx saveEditUser now omits role from PUT body when the target is super_admin. As super_admin via UI, editing the seeded super_admin (name + phone) returned 200 with toast 'User updated', dialog closed, and table reflected the new name. Editing a non-super_admin (member) user also succeeded with 200. Backend curl confirms PUT /api/users/{sa_id} without role => 200 while PUT with role='super_admin' still 422 (backend unchanged). Regression checks on previously-passing flows are still green.
passed: UI: SA opens Edit dialog for super_admin target, role select rendered with Super Admin item, change name/phone, Save -> PUT /api/users/{sa_id} returns 200, toast 'User updated' shown, dialog closes, table shows 'Super Admin Final'
UI: SA edits member (non super_admin) target -> PUT 200, table updates to 'Member One Renamed'
API: PUT /api/users/{sa_id} body without role (as SA) -> 200; body with role='super_admin' -> still 422 (backend Literal unchanged, confirming the frontend fix is required and correct)
API: PUT /api/users/{member_id} as SA with role='member' -> 200 (role changes for non super_admin still persist)
Regression: PUT /api/users/{admin_id} as admin -> 403 'Admins can only edit Member or Manpower users'
Auth: super_admin and admin (adm@t.com) cookie logins work; member1 login works after SA reset

success_rate.frontend: 100% on targeted Users edit flows (SA target + member target)
